ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 4:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white regions occupy the central 80% of both lobes; low-intensity black pixels form a continuous border along the trailing edge and an irregular, vertically-oriented cluster originating at the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped vertex with an interior angle measured at approximately 60 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 3 to 12 pixels along the continuous trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curve profile on the trailing edges of both lobes, tapering to acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, roughly circular high-relief pixel clusters (barnacles) are localized at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, near-vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are detected across the high-intensity white regions, predominantly on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible barnacle colonization on both distal lobe tips and significant vertical linear abrasions on the interior ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive 'dripping' pattern of low-intensity black pigmentation extending from the median notch into the high-intensity white field.
